notes.title: Build 46 - Custom Name & Fixes
notes.content:
Build 46 - Custom Name & Fixes

Royal players can now select their custom in-game name (Options-General-Custom Name). Peasants cannot. Donating to the fountain increases rainy day chance slightly!

Changelist
- added custom names for royal players
- added small rainy chance increase on donations (idea from richie!)
- added new french localizations (thanks Sinay69)
- fixed join url handling
- fixed royal mode being active for all modes
- fixed some npcs save data
- fixed being sleepy after load game
- fixed some places npcs got stuck
- fixed some minor ui bugs
- fixed buying farms from other players
- fixed inventory starting slots

Thanks for all the bug reports and tips! Helps a lot!

notes.title: Build 43 - Saves & Fixes
notes.content:
Build 43 - Saves & Fixes

Save Game (experimental) - You can now 'resume' any offline or sandbox game. The game saves automatically at the end of each day.
Join Game (experimental) - If you leave and rejoin a network game, you should continue with the same character / items / etc now.
Bugfixes - Fixed most of the bugs reported, keep them coming!

There was a huge internal reworking for handling the save games / player ID stuff, so please let me know if there's any issues, especially after resuming a save game or rejoining a network game. Note that the rejoin works even on a game loaded later (just think of it as all 'players' saved into the save file). There are some network limits in some cases, but it should be okay. 

Note that the Options version changed, so your options will be reset!
Note that sandbox and offline are seperate saves!

Changelist:
- added experimental 'save game' support
- added experimental 'rejoin game' support
- added game mode / region to invite links
- options version change (options will be reset!)
- changed default region to 'usw'
- increase shipping box limit to 128
- increase glasses girl sell price to 1.5x shipping price
- increase message on-screen time to 10s
- fix several festival mode bugs
- fix overflow on bag slot upgrades (limit at 24)
- fixed network issue where can sell to glasses girl
- fix various issues in time setting in network games
- fix various issues with invite code / links

Big thanks to everyone for playing, and double extra thanks for everyone submitting bug reports and details! Come say hi! http://discord.gg/cWKYw3Z
